xna-type.name: MediaLibrary
xna-type.summary: Provides access to songs, playlists, and pictures in the device's media library.
xna-type.remarks: MediaLibrary provides the following properties that return media collections: Albums , Artists , Genres , Pictures , Playlists , and Songs . Each property returns a collection object that can be enumerated and indexed. The collection object represents all media of that type in the device's media library. The media collections do not retrieve or instantiate all media objects immediately. Instead, when needed, you can use the collections later to retrieve individual media objects, such as Song and Artist objects. On Windows, MediaLibrary cannot find any songs unless the Windows Media Player previously found songs on the system. That means that Windows Media Player must first search the system for music before any songs can be accessed through MediaLibrary .

constructor.summary: Initializes a new instance of the MediaLibrary class, using a specific media source to create the new media library.

parameters.parameter: A media source that will be the source for the media library.

constructor.summary: Initializes a new instance of the MediaLibrary class.

property.name: Albums
property.summary: Gets the AlbumCollection that contains all albums in the media library.

property.name: Artists
property.summary: Gets the ArtistCollection that contains all artists in the media library.

property.name: Genres
property.summary: Gets the GenreCollection that contains all genres in the media library.

property.name: IsDisposed
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the object is disposed.

property.name: MediaSource
property.summary: Gets the MediaSource with which this media library was constructed.

property.name: Pictures
property.summary: Gets the PictureCollection that contains all pictures in the media library.

property.name: Playlists
property.summary: Gets the PlaylistCollection that contains all playlists in the media library.

property.name: RootPictureAlbum
property.summary: Gets the root PictureAlbum for all pictures in the media library.

property.name: SavedPictures
property.summary: Returns the collection of all saved pictures in the device's media library.
property.remarks: SavedPictures is only supported on Windows Phone, and returns an empty PictureCollection on Windows and Xbox 360.

property.name: Songs
property.summary: Gets the SongCollection that contains all songs in the media library.

method.name: Dispose
method.summary: Releases the resources used by the MediaLibrary.

overload.summary: Releases the resources used by the MediaLibrary.
overload.remarks: Call Dispose only when you are finished using the MediaLibrary . The Dispose method leaves the MediaLibrary in an unusable state. After calling Dispose , you must release all references to the MediaLibrary in order for the garbage collector to reclaim the memory that the MediaLibrary was occupying. For more information, see Cleaning Up Unmanaged Resources and Implementing a Dispose Method .

method.name: Finalize
method.summary: Releases unmanaged resources and performs other cleanup operations before the MediaLibrary is reclaimed by garbage collection.

overload.summary: Releases unmanaged resources and performs other cleanup operations before the MediaLibrary is reclaimed by garbage collection.
overload.remarks: This method overrides Finalize System.Object.Finalize . Application code should not call this method. The object's Finalize method is automatically invoked during garbage collection, unless a call to the GC.SuppressFinalize method has disabled finalization by the garbage collector. For more information, see Finalize Methods and Destructors , Cleaning Up Unmanaged Resources , and Overriding the Finalize Method .

method.name: GetPictureFromToken
method.summary: Retrieves a picture from the device's media library based on a picture token.

overload.summary: Retrieves a picture from the device's media library based on a picture token.

parameters.parameter: The picture token. This cannot be null

overload.returns: Type: Picture The Picture object that matches the supplied picture token.

method.name: SavePicture
method.summary: Saves the image to the media library, and then returns that saved image as a picture object.

overload.summary: Saves the image to the media library, and then returns that saved image as a picture object.

parameters.parameter: Name of the image file saved to the media library.
Buffer that contains the image in the required JPEG file format.

overload.returns: Type: Picture The Picture object that represents the saved image.
overload.remarks: Image data that is passed in must be in a JPEG file format. Additionally, SavePicture always saves the image in a JPEG file format.

overload.summary: Saves the image contained in the stream object to the media library, and then returns that saved image as a picture object.

parameters.parameter: Name of the image file that is saved to the media library.
Stream object that contains the image information in the required JPEG file format.

overload.returns: Type: Picture The Picture object that represents the saved image.
overload.remarks: Image data that is passed in must be in a JPEG file format. SavePicture always saves the image in a JPEG file format.
